name: SyncTogether - Watch Party
subtitle: Long-Distance Movie Night
description:
Movie night, even when you're apart. SyncTogether plays the same video at the same moment on every phone, tablet and computer in the room, so you can watch together and react together.

When anyone plays, pauses or seeks, everyone stays in lockstep. Late joiners are brought straight to the right spot.

KEY FEATURES

• STRICT LOCKSTEP PLAYBACK
Automatic drift correction and a readiness gate that waits until everyone is ready. Play, pause, scrub and seek together.

• TWO WAYS TO WATCH
- YouTube: paste a public YouTube link and start watching together.
- Your own videos: pick an MP4, MKV, MOV or WebM from the Files app. SyncTogether checks that everyone has the same file, and signed-in hosts can optionally stream their file to members who do not have a copy.

• VOICE AND VIDEO FACECAMS
See and hear your friends' reactions right beside the video.

• CHAT AND ANIMATED REACTIONS
Room chat with typing indicators, plus quick emoji reactions that float across the screen.

• INSTANT PRIVATE ROOMS
Create a room in seconds and share a 6-character code or an invite link. Members can report and block anyone who misbehaves.

• PRIVACY-FIRST
No ads and no selling of personal data. Join as a guest with one tap, or sign in with Apple, Google or an email code. You can delete your account from your profile at any time.

• ONE ACCOUNT EVERYWHERE
Your rooms, streaks and Premium follow you across devices.

SYNCTOGETHER PATRON (OPTIONAL)
Patron is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly, that unlocks up to 16 watchers per room, up to 20 active rooms, persistent rooms, video facecams, watch sessions up to 24 hours and extended animated reactions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://synctogether.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://synctogether.app/privacy
